papers.title_en: Rethinking One Gene, One Token: Transcriptome-Aware Tokenization for Single-Cell Foundation Models
papers.authors: Jiaqi Xiong, Jiaying Li, Yu Zheng, Xiang Zhou, Ziteng Wang, Xinting Hu, Jiaxin Qi
papers.evidence: 转录组感知分词通过基因集合共享压缩token，提升单细胞基础模型效率
papers.tldr: 单细胞基础模型通常把每个基因当作一个 token，计算昂贵且浪费，许多低表达基因信号弱。scTAT 用重叠基因集词表与逐细胞 tokenizer，让基因集和单基因按表达分数竞争 token 位置。冻结嵌入的细胞类型注释中，它以一半 token 预算匹配最强单基因模型，预算缩小时优势扩大。这表明 token 不必严格对应一个基因，可在不损注释精度下覆盖更多转录组。
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell foundation models typically treat each gene as a token, which is both costly and wasteful. A cell can express thousands of genes, so one token per gene makes self-attention expensive, yet many of these genes are detected at low levels and carry too little signal to deserve a token of their own. Genes that are expressed together could instead share a token, leaving separate tokens for genes that stand out. We introduce scTAT (Transcriptome-Aware Tokenization), which pairs a gene-set vocabulary with a per-cell tokenizer. The vocabulary holds overlapping gene sets that recur with stable relative expression across the pretraining corpus. Using these sets raises two difficulties. First, which genes should share a token depends on the cell, whereas existing multi-gene tokens fix the grouping in advance. Second, gene sets of different sizes must be compared with single genes on a common scale. The tokenizer therefore decides per cell, letting gene sets and single genes compete for token positions under an expression score normalized by the square root of set size. Training still reconstructs individual genes, so predictions stay at gene resolution. In frozen-embedding cell-type annotation, scTAT matches the strongest one-gene-per-token model with half the token budget. Its advantage over one-gene-per-token models at the same budget grows as the budget shrinks and the tokenizer assigns more positions to gene sets. Encoding the same genes with gene-set tokens also nearly halves the Transformer's matrix-multiplication cost. These results show that a token need not hold exactly one gene: when the tokenizer decides per cell which genes share a token, a fixed budget covers more of each transcriptome at no cost in annotation accuracy.

papers.title_en: Shared clones make random cell halves look reproducible in pooled screens
papers.evidence: 用于训练与评估扰动模型的单细胞扰动筛选可重复性
papers.tldr: 在Perturb-seq等pooled筛选中，常把同一扰动的细胞随机分半当作独立重复来评估可重复性。但细胞源自有限转导克隆，两个半份共享克隆，形成未标记的伪重复。作者用无效应扰动和独立转导重复对比，发现随机分半几乎总是一致，独立重复仅约一半一致；按TCR恒定区或克隆条码分半后超额一致性消失。共享克隆会抬高基准上限和可靠性标签，也会让同转导输入与答案的模型虚高，因此应跨独立转导评估可重复性。
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell perturbation screens are used to train and evaluate models of perturbation effects, and model scores are judged against the reproducibility of the measured effects. Reproducibility is usually judged by splitting each perturbation's cells into two random halves, assumed to be independent replicates. In pooled screens such as Perturb-seq, the cells carrying a guide RNA descend from a limited number of transduced cells, so two random halves contain the same clones: pseudoreplication whose unit is not marked in the data. Using null perturbations (no expected effect) as controls, we compared random halves with independent replicates from separate transductions, and tested directly with halves that differ only in their clones. In a genome-scale screen of primary T cells, null perturbations agreed between random halves almost always and between independent replicates only half the time, the rate expected from noise alone; more cells did not remove it. With halves that share no clone, split by the T-cell receptor constant region or by a clone barcode, the excess agreement largely disappeared. Under a simple model, consistent with a screen that recorded clones, its size equals the share of expression differences set by clones divided by the effective number of clones per perturbation; in cell lines an upper bound on it was small. In the T-cell screen, shared clones inflated benchmark ceilings and reliability labels, the more so in donors with fewer effective clones, and when a model's input and scoring answer come from one transduction, published models that predict effects in a new cell state scored well even on perturbations with no expected effect; for the model tested (STATE), the gain vanished with the same guide from another transduction as answer. Reproducibility is better judged across separate transductions than between random halves.

papers.title_en: Escaping cells dilute CRISPR screen responses unequally across cell types
papers.evidence: 量化CRISPR逃逸比例对扰动响应的稀释及其跨细胞类型差异，影响跨细胞类型迁移模型
papers.tldr: 单细胞CRISPR筛选常假设携带gRNA的细胞均被有效敲低，但必需基因敲低会造成细胞耗竭，逃逸敲低的细胞继续增殖并稀释平均响应。作者将逃逸比例定义为未有效敲低细胞占比，并利用靶基因计数和两组分混合模型从单细胞数据中估计。多数细胞类型中逃逸比例随基因必需性升高，同一细胞后期筛选更高，在hESC中可达约一半。该比例可预测响应稀释幅度，提示应基于敲低细胞比较或校正逃逸比例。
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell CRISPR screens run in many cell types are used to compare how cell types respond to perturbation, to train models that transfer effects between them and to score such models. These uses assume that cells carrying a guide RNA had their target knocked down. Yet cells grow for days before sequencing: when an essential gene is knocked down, knocked-down cells are depleted or stop dividing while cells that escaped knockdown keep growing, and the measured response, an average over all cells carrying the guide, is diluted. We define the escape fraction of a perturbation as the share of its measured cells whose target was not effectively knocked down, and estimate it from each cell's counts of the targeted gene with a two-group mixture that recovers known fractions in simulated mixtures. In most cell types the escape fraction rises with how essential the gene is, it is higher in a later screen of the same cells, and it reaches about half of the measured cells in human embryonic stem cells (hESCs). It predicts how much each response is diluted: the response size falls to (1 - e)^2 of that of the knocked-down cells. Because the escape fraction differs between cell types, it changes all three uses: hESCs respond like K562 cells unless knockdown depletes them, the coefficient a simple transfer model learns is lowered by the dilution of the cell type it predicts, and a benchmark scored on all cells rewards predictions shrunk towards no change, partly because that ground truth is itself diluted. Where cells stop dividing instead, the response also contains expression differences between cell-cycle stages. Response sizes should be compared on knocked-down cells or corrected for the escape fraction.

papers.title_en: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Time Series Foundation Models for Electrical Load Forecasting
papers.authors: Aliullah, Julian Oelhaf, Edouard Fouché, Jessica Deuschel, Christian Bergler, Andreas Maier, Siming Bayer
papers.evidence: 基础模型上LoRA与全量微调对比并含分布外评估
papers.tldr: 电力负荷预测常需针对不同聚合层级重复建模，预训练时间序列基础模型虽可复用但未必充分适配负荷特性。本文在四个负荷聚合层级上比较预训练推理、全量微调与LoRA，并以MOIRAI 1.0 Large为主、Chronos-2验证跨模型迁移。MOIRAI上rank-16 LoRA平均降低NMAE 7.5%，仅更新约1%参数并保留大部分全量微调收益。结果表明LoRA在强预训练检查点上能提供较好的精度—效率权衡，但OOD增益因目标而异。
papers.abstract_en: Accurate electrical load forecasting supports power-system operation across countries, regions, cities, and buildings, but repeated development of target-specific models is costly. Time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide reusable pretrained backbones, although multi-domain pretraining may not fully capture load-specific characteristics. This paper compares pretrained inference, full fine-tuning, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) in terms of forecasting accuracy and adaptation efficiency across four electrical load aggregation levels. MOIRAI 1.0 Large serves as the primary backbone, while Chronos-2 assesses whether the findings transfer across model families. The evaluation covers both in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings and examines whether compact adaptation provides consistent gains over strong pretrained checkpoints. Pretrained foundation models outperform the implemented seasonal naive and XGBoost baselines across the evaluated aggregation levels. On MOIRAI Large, rank-16 LoRA reduces normalized mean absolute error (NMAE) by 7.5% on average while updating 3.146 million parameters, about 1% of the model, and retains most of the improvement from full fine-tuning. Chronos-2 achieves lower pretrained NMAE than MOIRAI, while its relative adaptation gains remain smaller overall. OOD results show that adaptation benefits vary by target, with the clearest gains for the local-area series and several buildings. Overall, LoRA provides a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off when adaptation yields a meaningful gain over a strong pretrained checkpoint.

papers.title_en: NormTune: Norm-Guided Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Reasoning-Intensive Tasks
papers.authors: Zhangming Li, Qinghao Hu, Weifan Guan, Yifan Zhang, Peisong Wang, Jian Cheng
papers.evidence: 通用参数高效微调方法，可迁移用于单细胞基础模型的高效适配
papers.tldr: 全量微调在推理密集型任务上表现强但GPU开销高，而PEFT存在明显性能差距，作者将其归因于权重更新范数偏小的欠适配。提出NormTune，按层权重更新范数自适应增强更新不足的层。在S1K-1.1上，rank-8 LoRA/Bone/MoRA平均准确率分别提升24.24%、11.33%、16.21%；rank-256版本可接近全量微调。该工作为推理任务提供简单有效的PEFT增强策略。
papers.abstract_en: Full fine-tuning has achieved remarkable success on reasoning-intensive tasks, but it often requires substantial GPU resource consumption. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) provides a promising alternative for reducing this cost, yet we observe a substantial performance gap on reasoning-intensive tasks. In this paper, we present three key observations showing that this gap is closely associated with norm-related under-adaptation, where PEFT produces markedly smaller weight-update norms than full fine-tuning. Based on these observations, we propose Norm-Guided Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (NormTune), a simple yet effective strategy that adaptively strengthens insufficiently updated layers according to their weight-update norms. Extensive experiments show that NormTune consistently enhances multiple PEFT methods across challenging reasoning benchmarks. Specifically, when trained on S1K-1.1, integrating NormTune into rank-8 LoRA, Bone, and MoRA yields substantial average accuracy improvements of 24.24\%, 11.33\%, and 16.21\% , respectively, across AIME 2024, MATH 500, GPQA, and AIME 2025. Moreover, NormTune-enhanced rank-256 LoRA, Bone, and MoRA achieve performance comparable to S1 full fine-tuning, with respective average gains of 2.17\%, 0.93\%, and 3.00\% over this baseline.

papers.title_en: CaLLM: Continual Adaptation of LLMs via Non-Parametric Adapter Routing
papers.authors: Bilge Celik, Anna Vettoruzzo, Joaquin Vanschoren
papers.evidence: 轻量适配器加原型路由实现参数高效持续适配
papers.tldr: 针对LLM持续适应中的灾难遗忘与任务到专家分配困难，CaLLM将每个输入批次映射到任务无关嵌入空间并匹配最近原型，再路由至对应轻量适配器。该设计实现可控的跨任务干扰、恒定计算开销，并通过原型扩展无缝接入新分布；局部路由决策还统一了在线与离线场景。实验在多样细粒度持续学习基准上稳定优于传统隔离与回放方法，且额外路由开销保持在很低水平，为LLM终身适应提供了可扩展范式。
papers.abstract_en: Continual adaptation of large language models (LLMs) to evolving task distributions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting remains an open problem. Existing strategies often struggle to scale or lack a robust mechanism for zero-shot task-to-expert assignment. We introduce CaLLM, a framework that resolves these tensions by combining metric-based meta-learning with modular parameter isolation via lightweight adapters. First, CaLLM projects each input batch into a task-agnostic embedding space to find its nearest prototype. It then routes the batch to the specific adapter specialized for that data distribution. This formulation provides (i)~controllable cross-task interference by design, (ii)~constant computational complexity regardless of task count, (iii)~seamless integration of novel distributions through prototype expansion, and (iv)~regime agnosticism as the local routing decision enables a unified approach to both online and offline settings. Our experiments demonstrate that this routing mechanism discovers semantically coherent task groupings while facilitating constructive interference between similar tasks, and keeping overhead at a minimum. Across diverse and fine-grained continual learning benchmarks, CaLLM consistently outperforms traditional isolation and replay methods, establishing prototype-based modular routing as a principled and scalable approach to lifelong adaptation of LLMs.

papers.title_en: Learning developmental dynamics from lineage context
papers.authors: Gokul Gowri, Nic Fishman, William N. Colgan, Minming Wang, Yusuke Kijima, Sachin A. Kumar, Aleksandr Zimin, Luke W. Koblan, Marinka Zitnik, Zachary D. Smith, Stephen Bates, Philippe Rigollet, Jonathan S. Weissman
papers.evidence: 生成式细胞状态动态并可推断扰动响应
papers.tldr: 多细胞发育动力学预测需要超越单细胞基因表达的信息，谱系上下文有望提供关键约束。作者提出lineage inpainting，用树结构Transformer和随机插值在谱系树上生成建模细胞状态动态。在小鼠胚胎发育谱系追踪转录图谱中，该方法恢复基因表达单独无法解析的动态，并识别多个谱系转录汇聚事件。模型还能通过反事实模拟提出扰动响应假设，部分与Tbx5敲除等表型一致，显示谱系上下文是学习多细胞动力学的重要信息源。
papers.abstract_en: A central goal of biology is to predict the dynamics of multicellular systems. Lineage context (the states of a cell's sisters, cousins, etc.) could inform these predictions, but how best to leverage it remains unclear. Here we introduce lineage inpainting, a generative modeling approach that uses lineage context with tree-structured transformers and stochastic interpolants to model cell state dynamics across lineage trees. Applied to a lineage-traced transcriptional atlas of mouse embryogenesis, it recovers dynamics not resolved by gene expression alone, including multiple transcriptional convergence events where distinct lineages are drawn to a common state. Despite being fit on unperturbed development, lineage inpainting can generate hypotheses about perturbation responses by simulating counterfactuals. These simulations agree in many cases with observed developmental phenotypes, including a single-cell measurement of the Tbx5 knockout response. Our results show that lineage information provides a rich source of context for learning multicellular dynamics.
